evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rose monotonically from ~3 ppm to 32 ppm during growth (11.6, 18.8, 23.3, 32.4) after stable ~5 ppm baseline
Temperature at setpoint 750 °C, heater power stable ~44%, Ar 100 sccm, pressure ~760 Torr — all nominal

args.missing_evidence: Response of O2 to an Ar flow step or pressure change (a leak-rate test) would distinguish an air in-leak from an O2 sensor drift or outgassing source.
